_comment: Community-established FT4/FT8 calling frequencies for amateur satellites.
_comment2: These are NOT in the SATNOGS database. Source: JH1NHK @JH1NHK (https://x.com/JH1NHK/status/1882598594924212321)
_comment3: Format: Rx=downlink, Tx=uplink. Frequencies may change as community conventions evolve. Last reviewed: 2026-06-01.

description: FT4 Calling — community standard (V/U inverting transponder)
notes: Community FT4 calling frequency within the V/U inverting transponder passband. Rx 435.612 / Tx 145.9906. Catalog uplink is 145.993; many JA stations use 145.9906 (2026-09-30), reached via the default per-transponder UL Offset (ul_offset_hz = -2400, seeded once per install; user changes are kept) rather than by editing this value. Matches the value many JA stations actually use (Rymansat Satellite Tracker's bundled default, github.com/RymansatSatelliteTracker/RST, satellite_data/frequency.json uplink3 -- traced back to PR #182's source table). Not in SATNOGS. Original ref: JH1NHK https://x.com/JH1NHK/status/1882598594924212321

description: FT4 Calling — community standard (U/V inverting transponder)
notes: Community FT4 calling frequency within the U/V inverting transponder passband. Rx 145.857 / Tx 435.118. Not in SATNOGS. Ref: JH1NHK https://x.com/JH1NHK/status/1882598594924212321. invert=true confirmed 2026-08-02 against SATNOGS' own 'U/V SSB Transponder' entry for this satellite (downlink mode=USB, uplink_mode=LSB) after a user report that FT4 mode selection set Sub (UL) to USB-D instead of LSB-D.
Community FT4 calling frequency. Rx 435.812 / Tx 145.938. Not in SATNOGS. Ref: JH1NHK https://x.com/JH1NHK/status/1882598594924212321

description: FT4 Calling — community standard (U/V inverting transponder)
notes: Community FT4 calling frequency, 2 kHz above the bottom edge of the U/V linear transponder passband — same offset confirmed against RS-44/JO-97/MO-122 (SATNOGS-registered passband UL 435.130-435.150 / DL 145.950-145.970 MHz, invert=true, uplink_mode=LSB). Rx 145.952 / Tx 435.148. Not in SATNOGS as a dedicated FT4 entry. Requested on GitHub Issue #16 (ei4gnb), 2026-08-08.

GMSK ASM+Golay digipeater rides at a fixed audio offset inside an SSB passband (GreenCube's own approach), not a standard FM/AFSK transponder. SATNOGS now lists the real NORAD 69912 row as 'Mode V/V Digipeater' (mode 'FSK AX.100 Mode 5'); this override corrects it to USB, Up=Down=145.875 MHz. Re-pointed from the provisional id 98272 to 69912 on 2026-09-06 (load_community_transmitters keys on uuid and updates norad_cat_id in place). 2026-07.
Ground-based simplex APRS (DATA-FM) for testing between handhelds and the base rig. Pseudo-satellite NORAD -2 (core.engine.TERRESTRIAL_IDS): no TLE, no Doppler correction.
Ground-based simplex APRS (DATA-FM) for testing between handhelds and the base rig. Pseudo-satellite NORAD -3 (core.engine.TERRESTRIAL_IDS): no TLE, no Doppler correction.

9600 baud GMSK AX.25 UI telemetry on 400.500 MHz. SATNOGS lists only a bare 'Mode U - Transmitter' (GFSK 9600) with no framing information. Framing taken from SV2HWM's 2026-07-09 reception (https://x.com/SV2HWM/status/2075203916862497153): GetKISS shows AX.25 UI frames (control 03, PID F0; addresses read as SP6KZ / SP5QNA, an 'Endurosat' text frame and binary telemetry). Not yet decoded by FBSAT59 itself. 2026-10.

Melody beacon on 400.500 MHz: a two-tone FSK pair about 4.8 kHz apart keyed by a square-wave note, so plain narrow FM demodulation plays it as a melody (no digital protocol). Repeats about every 180 s. Confirmed on a Doppler-corrected IQ recording of 2026-10-16 (NFM, +/-9 kHz IF) and on SV2HWM's 2026-07-09 recording (https://x.com/SV2HWM/status/2075203916862497153). Not in SATNOGS. 2026-10.
Melody beacon on the same frequency as the GFSK 4k8 AX.25 telemetry (400.500 MHz); plain narrow FM demodulation plays it. Reported as confirmed by the user (2026-10-15). Not in SATNOGS. 2026-10.

Melody beacon on the same frequency as the GFSK 9k6 AX.25 telemetry (401.025 MHz); plain narrow FM demodulation plays it. Confirmed on the user's Doppler-corrected IQ recording of 2026-10-14 (a stepped tone sequence of 391-586 Hz notes after FM demodulation, in the same band as the 60 s telemetry bursts), and reported as confirmed by the user (2026-10-15). Not in SATNOGS. 2026-10.

Melody beacon near the UHF telemetry frequency (400.360 MHz, the GMSK 4k8 AX.25 entry); plain narrow FM demodulation plays it. Reported as confirmed by the user (2026-10-15). Its exact carrier relative to 400.360 MHz was not measured; the NFM +/-9 kHz IF tolerates a few kHz. SATNOGS has a separate FM 'Telemetry' row at 400.356 MHz. Not in SATNOGS as a music entry. 2026-10.

description: APRS digipeater OK0LSR 9k6 GFSK AX.25 G3RUH (half duplex, same frequency)
notes: LASARsat digipeater: uplink and downlink are both 436.925 MHz, half duplex; the satellite repeats a packet shortly after hearing it. Put OK0LSR in the digipeater path. Source: https://lasar.io/lasarsat and the Libre Space Community thread "AX25 software/hardware" (dl7ndr). Rules of use not published.
